children: NewAmsterdam Pharma announced dosing the first participant in SPINOZA, a Phase 2b trial testing obicetrapib in preclinical Alzheimer’s disease.
SPINOZA is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2b trial enrolling ~400 participants with biomarker evidence of preclinical Alzheimer’s.
Participants (ApoE4/E4, ApoE3/E4, ApoE3/E3) randomized 1:1 to obicetrapib 10 mg or placebo for 52 weeks, then optional 26-week open-label extension.
Primary endpoint is change in plasma p-tau217 at Week 52; secondary endpoints include Aβ42/Aβ40, BD-tau and PACC5 cognitive score changes.
Trial design informed by BROADWAY biomarker analysis that showed statistically significant lower p-tau217 change with obicetrapib versus placebo.
